_readme: CDN: publicBase is already served on Cloudflare's global CDN (pub-….r2.dev). For production, connect a custom domain to the bucket (e.g. assets.yourdomain.com) in R2 → Settings → Public URL → Custom Domain, then set publicBase and VITE_R2_PUBLIC_BASE_URL to that URL. New uploads get Cache-Control headers automatically. Re-upload old PDFs once so they cache at the edge. Test: open publicBase + '/' + brochureUrl in a browser before redeploying.
